points.description: Names slow start and describes its change: cwnd grows (increases per ACK, roughly doubling each RTT / exponentially) while cwnd is below ss_thresh, until ss_thresh is reached or a loss occurs.
points.partial_credit: Names slow start but only says cwnd increases, or describes growth without naming the phase.

points.description: Names congestion avoidance and describes its change: cwnd grows more slowly/linearly (e.g. +1 per RTT) once cwnd >= ss_thresh, until a loss occurs.
points.partial_credit: Names congestion avoidance but gives only vague growth, or describes slower growth without naming the phase.

points.description: On packet loss/congestion, ss_thresh is set to cwnd/2 and cwnd is reset to 1 (ss_thresh stays unchanged otherwise).
points.partial_credit: Gives only one of ss_thresh = cwnd/2 or cwnd reset to 1.

rubric.notes: Full marks need both phases (slow start, congestion avoidance) with how cwnd changes in each, plus the loss reaction (ss_thresh = cwnd/2, cwnd = 1). Informal wording is fine, such as 'doubles' or 'grows fast then slowly'. Give part marks for a correct phase with vague growth or an incomplete loss reaction. Wrong extra remarks cost nothing unless they contradict the main idea, for example swapping which phase is exponential.
